public_rationale: The records support substantial agreement about shortcomings in current systems, especially LeCun's emphasis on physical understanding and world models. They do not establish the complete claim about both speakers and their contrast with many others. Other researchers were publicly making related arguments, but those examples do not settle the unspecified comparison.
limitations: Public agreement does not establish who originated an idea or whether one speaker changed his position.
Dropping the comparison clause would produce a materially narrower assessment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Marcus and LeCun, unlike many other people, now both stress that common sense, physical reasoning and world models are absolutely essential, and that current architectures fail to handle them well.

statement.excerpt: Nowadays we both (unlike many other people) stress the absolutely essential nature of common sense, physical reasoning and world models, and the failure of current architectures to handle those well.
statement.document_title: Open letter responding to Yann LeCun

from_speaker: absolutely essential nature of common sense, physical reasoning and world models
failure of current architectures to handle those well
our_interpretation: Assess the public positions of Marcus and LeCun, not whether their technical views are correct.
Interpret 'nowadays' as their current public positions in 2024 through June 4. With no regular reporting cycle for public positions, use that year-to-date reporting window.
Treat 'absolutely essential' as necessary for broadly capable AI, rather than necessary for every useful AI application.
Retain the comparison with 'many other people'; agreement between the two speakers alone cannot establish the complete proposition.
criteria.support_condition: Public records establish that both speakers emphasized all three requirements and current architectural shortcomings, with credible comparative evidence that a substantial group of relevant AI commentators did not share that emphasis.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous records show either speaker materially rejected the attributed position, or systematic comparative evidence disproves the claimed contrast under an identified comparison population.
